playstyle: The most unorthodox character in the game (Wavu): a defensive stance specialist. Soul Stealer (Flash, 1+4) is a blazing i6 mid that punishes almost anything, his parries stop attacks cold, and his many stances make him hard to read. His defensive tools are strong but very unsafe when guessed wrong, so use them as reads, not habits.

stances.name: Indian Stance
stances.note: A meditation-style stance; check the Move Library for its options.

stances.name: No Sword Stance
stances.note: NSS.1+4 is an i8 launch (situational, Wavu). In Heat, powered-up NSS moves come out in 1SS.

stances.name: Manji Dragonfly
stances.note: A flying stance; DGF.4 is a Heat Engager.

stances.name: Flea
stances.note: A crouching hop stance for evasive mix-ups.
